question: After refreshing this test-only branch onto current `main`, should the Slack test-stability repair be merged under the existing protected maintainer review label?
rationale: The patch has focused repeated test evidence and no identified mechanical defect, but the protected `maintainer` label and base drift require an explicit human merge decision.

options.title: Refresh and merge
